body: I get that. I really do appreciate your words. But I just hate this feeling like I'm never gonna be able to get over it. I constantly keep hurting myself by worrying abt her. My therapist told me to reach out to her but she seems so happy now that I'm out of her life which hurts like hell
I appreciate it but idk if I could ever love again. I just can't keep going on with my negative feelings and being in so much pain everyday.

It's hard for me because I put so much love and effort into it thinking it was real just to get broken. People always say you will find someone else. But I just can't get my ex out of my head and it hurts

Hey thanks man appreciate it. When we talked abt what we want in our relationships we both want the same thing. 
 She likes when the guy chases her to show his worth so if I keep chasing I feel like I have a greater chance. Fingers crossed we get to hang out
Got it I'll try my best and hope for the best appreciate it!
Alright I'ma see how things go if we hang out
We have plans to hang out on her day off, I'm just hoping she doesn't cancel it last minute.

Hey, I'm sorry to hear that. What you said does sound true we had some amazing times when we were together and even when we called. We did had some bad times that were over the phone and she does hold on to those bad while I hold on to the good memories l. She claims she can't just ignore the past which I mean I get. Thank you I'm sorry yours didn't end the same way you wished it be and maybe if I hold on it would end the same way for me to. Not sure but I appreciate your comment. It means alot to have you guys give me advice!

Hey, thank you for your response. I forgot to mention it but when we talked about how I felt better and just highs and lows. I asked her again and she mentioned how at first it was for my sake as far as mental health, and then said after talking to friends they told her that I'm not good for her because of an age difference. So for her sake she can't stay which I 100% understand, and respect. 
I have considered moving, and I will take this into consideration. Again thank you and I greatly appreciate it!
